# UI

Interaction preferences for frontend code. Pairs with `js.md` / `react.md`.

## Interaction

- Give enabled buttons and links a pointer cursor (`cursor-pointer`); pair it with `cursor-not-allowed` on the disabled state.
- If you remove the native focus outline, replace it with a visible custom focus style (e.g. a ring) - never remove it without a replacement.
